instances.system_name: Biomimetic Architectural Thermal Buffer Facade Panel
instances.problem_statement:
Target system: Biomimetic Architectural Thermal Buffer Facade Panel
Required function: passively buffer the interior against an intense daytime solar heat load by absorbing and storing the incident heat in a thin wall layer during the charging period, keeping the exposed surface temperature rise small, and releasing it later.
Environment / operating conditions:
- absorbed heat flux on the exposed face: 113.7 W/m^2 (constant)
- charging duration: 5.45 h
- energy that must be stored per unit area: 2.136 MJ/m^2
Hard constraints:
- layer thickness <= 41.0 mm
- areal mass <= 39.1 kg/m^2
- end-of-charge surface temperature rise above the storage transition temperature <= 10.6 K
